questions.prompt: Which class provides console input methods?
questions.explanation: The Console class in the System namespace provides Read, ReadLine, and ReadKey methods.

questions.prompt: What parameter does int.TryParse take for the output variable?
Arrange these to print two prompts and read two inputs.
questions.explanation: Prompt before each ReadLine call so the user knows what to enter.

questions.prompt: Why use Convert.ToInt32 instead of int.Parse?
questions.explanation: Convert.ToInt32 returns 0 for null input instead of throwing an exception.

questions.prompt: Read two integers and print their sum.

questions.explanation: Console.ReadKey returns a ConsoleKeyInfo object containing key, modifier, and character info.

questions.prompt: What is the namespace for Console?
Which parsing method is safest for invalid user input?
questions.explanation: int.TryParse is safest because it returns false instead of throwing on invalid input.
Always validate input with TryParse before trusting the value.

questions.prompt: What happens if you press Enter without typing anything?
questions.explanation: Console.ReadLine returns an empty string when the user presses Enter without typing anything.
